question: Which Image Tools phone navigation should I use: four readable tabs, menu only, or keep today’s eight cut-off tabs?
big_picture: On phones, eight places crowd the bottom bar until every name is cut to two or three letters; desktop is unaffected. This is a taste decision about how the app is organised, so you choose. Four keeps the editing places one tap away with readable names and puts all eight places in the menu; menu only gives the image more room but puts every place two taps away; keep leaves today’s crowded bar. If you do not answer, today’s bar stays as it is. After your answer, I update the phone layout and send you a capture.
reason: The editing places stay one tap away with readable names, and none of the eight places is lost.

options.label: Use four readable tabs and put all eight places in the menu
Remove the bottom bar and put all eight places in the menu
Keep today’s eight tabs with cut-off names
